# Supabase browser client

- Package: `@supabase/supabase-js` 2.117.2, MIT license.
- Browser distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.117.2/dist/umd/supabase.js
- License: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.117.2/LICENSE
- Downloaded 2026-09-29. Vendored without modification so member login does not need a runtime JavaScript CDN.
- SHA-256 of the browser distribution: `59d39487c3589843b410322d8a3d562ce022aba1e5ccb16898ef3fb2a0da2ecd`.

To update, review the official release, replace the versioned browser distribution and license, update the script path in `members.html`, and rerun unit, permission, and browser tests. Do not replace it with an unpinned `latest` URL.
